name: change-order-recovery-audit
description: Find cited change-order records that may be unpriced, unsigned, aging, contradictory, or apparently unbilled.
long_description: A private, read-only second-opinion audit for one construction project folder. Project files stay on the user's computer. Results require human review and do not determine entitlement or guarantee recovery.

tools.name: audit_change_order_folder
tools.description: Read one configured project folder and return cited possible change-order exposure for human review.

tools.name: manage_change_order_subscription
tools.description: Open the Stripe billing portal for the purchasing computer without reading the configured project folder.

project_directory.title: Project folder
project_directory.description: Select the single project folder this read-only audit may access.

license_key.title: Recovery or company key (optional)
license_key.description: Optional only for another computer or support recovery. The purchasing computer activates automatically after payment.
